description: This file defines the ConfigEntityTypeInterface interface in Drupal, which extends EntityTypeInterface and provides methods related to configuration entity types, including prefix length, prefix retrieval, properties to export, and lookup keys.

methods.name: getConfigPrefix
methods.description: Returns the configuration prefix used by the entity type, which is used to prefix configuration entity IDs in the system.

methods.name: getPropertiesToExport
methods.description: Returns an array of properties to export for a given configuration entity ID, or NULL if not determined.

methods.name: getLookupKeys
methods.description: Returns an array of keys available for fast lookup of configuration entities.
